column2: (1) The Board shall appoint a fit and proper person

column1: distinguished in the field of medicine or sports medicine as
Director-General  of  the  Agency  who  shall  be  the  Chief
Executive Officer of the Agency for a period of three years
and shall be eligible for reappointment.

column2: (2) The Director-General shall execute or perform such

column1: powers, functions and duties as may be delegated to him by
the Board. The Director-General may delegate to any member
of the Board any of his powers and duties.

column2: (1)  (a)  The  Board  may  establish  Committees  and

column1: Panels to assist it in the performance of its functions under
this Act and may appoint such persons as it may deem fit to
be members of any such Committee or Panel.

column2: (b) A Committee or Panel shall carry out its functions and

column1: fulfill its obligations as stipulated in the terms of reference
given to such Committee or Panel by the Board.

column2: (c) The Board may where it considers necessary, co-opt

column1: as  a  member  to  a  Committee  or  Panel  any  person  who
possesses  the  required  knowledge  and  expertise  in  the
relevent  field  for  the  purpose  of  finalizing  the  particular
matter  under  consideration.  Such  person  shall  not  be  a
permanent member and shall not have the right to vote in
respect  of  any  issue  which  may  arise  in  the  course  of  its
business.

column2: (d) The term of office of the members of any Committee

column1: or panel shall be four years.

column2: (e) Where a member of Committee or Panel dies or resigns,

column1: the  Board  may,  appoint  another  person  to  succeed  the
member who dies or resigns:

column2: Provided that the member so appointed in place of such

column1: member shall hold office only for the unexpired portion of
the term of office of the member whom he succeeds.
